classes.name: Marauder
classes.subtitle: Heavy hitting slow tank, melee.
classes.description: A master of brute force and resilience. Warriors excel at close-quarters combat, trading powerful blows with their enemies while shrugging off damage with heavy armor and high health.
classes.recommendedStats: Focus on Max Health, Armor, and Physical Damage. Strength and Resilience are your best friends to survive the front lines while crushing foes.

classes.name: Scoundrel
classes.subtitle: Squishy fast, normal damage, ranged.
classes.description: Quick, lethal, and precise. Rangers dominate from a distance, using their superior movement speed and evasion to stay out of reach while landing deadly critical strikes with bows.
classes.recommendedStats: Prioritize Attack Speed, Crit Chance, and Movement Speed. Stay agile and use Evasion to avoid taking hits, as your health pool is limited.

classes.name: Shadow
classes.subtitle: Jack of all trades, both melee and ranged, decent tankiness and damage.
classes.description: A ruthless tactician who fights for profit. Mercenaries utilize dirty tactics and utility to gain the upper hand, specializing in bleeds, critical multipliers, and experience gains.
classes.recommendedStats: Balance between Physical Damage and Utility. Crit Multiplier and Bleed Chance are great for damage, while Experience Bonus helps you outscale your enemies.
